review_scope: Independent read-only source, opening-host, code and actual-render visual review. Reviewer did not edit geometry or publish source images. This is not a structural, conservation, physical-print or exhaustive metric certification.

source_basis.report: 原臺北北警察署調查研究,2001-07
source_basis.explicit_sheet_basis: B2-1..B2-4 plans and roof; B3-1..B3-4 current-condition elevations; door/window indices and details used only for evidenced exterior positions.
source_basis.excluded: 243–245 blank-number index sheets excluded as geometry authority;246 A2-1A and subsequent repair proposals not used. No original source imagery included in this review.

front.png.observation: Whole front/left view: independent paired arches, lower rectangular fields, shared W11 corner band, recessed column entrance, open vehicle passage and circular fields readable.

rear.png.observation: Whole rear/right view: distinct projecting rear wing and recessed body hosts; corrected second-floor stair pane visible, third-floor separated tower-strip windows present.

front_elevation.png.observation: Ten main paired bays, one stair field and three terminal upper paired bays; no invented three ground terminal pairs. Front opening order maintained.

rear_elevation.png.observation: Rear facade remains multi-plane. Corrected three-column straight stair group and separate two-column return; tower-strip short/long windows present. External stair descends in source-evidenced direction.

left_elevation.png.observation: Single arched field plus four paired groups; W11 is shared corner not additional duplicate set. Two rear-wing western ground rectangles visible. No clipping of whole building.

right_elevation.png.observation: Five small upper main-body groups and largely blind lower main wall; four rear-wing columns with first partially occluded, consistent with projected source visibility.

top.png.observation: Top plan shows main curved corner, rear stair projection, separate semicircular rear wing and stepped end stub. Permanent rooftop stair and five simplified equipment tanks present. Temporary roof shed excluded as documented.

corner_detail.png.observation: Intentional close crop: W11 2/3/2 columns and tall lower bands clearly visible, arch grid has lower split only; portico and paired opaque entrance backing visible.

rear_detail.png.observation: Intentional close crop: rear-wing end retains three upper groups per row and blind ground end; recessed irregular lower openings and external stair visible without flattening hosts.

resolved_findings: W11 earlier reviewer height transcription corrected to246cm; lower band taller and group spacing source-qualified.
Arch internal central muntin restricted to lower split band, not uniform full-height two columns.
Rear-wing western ground pair of narrow rectangles retained despite blind northern detention end.
Second-floor rear stair pane relocated to its actual storey host and no longer hidden by wall.
Rear stair-strip third-floor separated short/long rectangular fields restored; uncertain lower patch not invented as window.
remaining_limitations: Raster-derived facade placements and differing surveyed extent chains retain approximation; no claim of exact measured restoration.
Rear level-chain discrepancy and excluded temporary rooftop shed disclosed in README/SOURCES.
Opaque glazing, blind backing, enlarged frames, tangent-faceted curves, canopy/ramp and external stair are authored display proxies.
Survey replacements/AC occlusions do not establish original frame materials.
No full detention interiors or concealed exterior windows inferred.
No physical trial print or safety claim.

documentation_review.README.md: Opening-related scope and uncertainty adequately disclosed; preview first section uses three-column grid.
documentation_review.SOURCES.md: W11 correction and sheet-series exclusion correctly recorded.
